ensemble_v7.interpretation: Adding Tier 0r as the 10th verifier in Group C (logic-class) dragged the group-conditional mean down because Tier 0r's solo AUROC on a 50-example synthetic eval (0.8256, exp2520) is well below the v6 Group C members (Tier 0d=0.588, Tier 0h=0.678). The Fisher-combined group conditional mean is sensitive to its weakest member; adding 0.8256 alongside ~0.6 verifiers does not lift the group. Real corpus + better-calibrated Tier 0r weighting needed before Tier 0r expands the ensemble.

Adaptive conformal v2 (exp2524) was not run because of the regression — it remains a candidate for .244 only after Tier 0r is correctly integrated or replaced.
